guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Use red-first behavioral tests for report presence, bindings, and cleanup ordering; do not rely only on source-text assertions.

guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Pre-merge bindings explicitly use lifecycleStage pre_merge and pullRequest.state not_created; Closure Receipt consumes only verified merged PR facts.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Fail closed before branch cleanup whenever required report evidence cannot be generated or validated.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep instruction-plan-implementation-acceptance traceability bidirectional and record any newly discovered workflow defect before continuing dependent Work Items.

risk.detail: Report generation and closure ordering affect immutable archive evidence and retryable branch cleanup; focused lifecycle tests are required.
